meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 变成“指挥者”:它会读取你指定的工作计划,把任务拆小后交给多个后台子代理并行执行,自己全程跟踪进度,且不会亲自动手写代码、改文件。若开启对应选项,它会按阶段把成果做成独立的拉取请求(PR),等你批准才合并。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-execute”或要求运行 `.omo/plans/` 下的计划时触发;若你尚无计划而明确表示“开始工作”,它也会先引导生成计划再执行。

say.text: 请执行 .omo/plans 里的重构计划。
say.note: Claude 会按计划把各任务分派出去并行执行。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute 运行 test-plan,并生成拉取请求。
say.note: 每个阶段的成果会以 PR 形式交给你审阅。

say.text: 没有计划,直接开始工作吧。
say.note: 它会先让 ulw-plan 生成计划,然后再执行。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it reads your plan, splits work into units, spawns background subagents to run in parallel, tracks progress, and never codes or edits itself. Optionally it delivers phases as pull requests and merges only on approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or ask to run a plan under `.omo/plans/`; if no plan exists and you say "start work", Claude first creates a plan, then executes it.

say_en.note: Tasks are delegated and run in parallel.

say_en.text: Run test-plan with ulw-execute and open a pull request.
say_en.note: Each phase is handed to you as a PR to review.

say_en.text: No plan yet — just start work.
say_en.note: Claude has ulw-plan draft one, then executes it.
